final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence; the response mainly narrows and reframes the claim using the same record. That reframing is substantively helpful in one respect: it correctly distinguishes general launch readiness evidence from named-context compliance predicates and rejects treating missing sanctions-risk explanation evals as passed. But that distinction is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here, because the unresolved issue is not merely wording style or proportionality of treatment. Policy requires the named-context gap to be disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before clean certification, and the admissible record still does not show any of those predicates have been satisfied. Aggregate readiness and general operational checks support readiness, not closure of the model-card disclosure obligation for the named deployment context.
